items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: But this was my first big band recording session. It was Benny's session, but he asked me to sing a couple of selections on it.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. Well I did a tour of one-night stands with Benny Carter. And at the end of the tour, he had a record session. And we sort of stayed up all night recording these things. This was the first -- well, not actually, because if you want to say a big band, the first one was with John Kirby -- I mean with Claude Thornhill, the very beginning. But this was my first big band recording session. It was Benny's session, but he asked me to sing a couple of selections on it.
Very refreshing kind of change, too, from some of the other materials.
